questions.passage: Meaningless jobs, according to Graeber, are not just repetitive factory or clerical jobs, but also include corporate lawyers, public relations consultants, telemarketers, and brand managers. For instance, he claims that most corporate lawyers secretly believe that the world would probably be a better place if they did not exist. Of course, people can make a difference in the world outside of their jobs. So this doesn’t mean corporate lawyers and public relations consultants lead meaningless lives.
questions.prompt: Why does the author say these occupations do not necessarily imply meaningless lives?
options: People can make a difference outside their jobs.
Graeber excludes all professional occupations from his argument.
The author claims that every corporate lawyer secretly enjoys the work.
A job’s repetitiveness guarantees a meaningful life.
questions.promptZh: 作者为什么说这些职业并不必然意味着无意义的人生？

工作的重复性保证人生有意义。
analyses: A outside of their jobs 是最后结论的直接理由。
B 列出的 corporate lawyers 等恰恰属于论述范围。
C 原文归于 Graeber 的说法涉及职业存在，不是所有人喜欢工作。
D 重复性不是人生有意义的保证。

questions.passage: As she shared with PBS NewsHour, Dr. Adams-Pickett delivered over 6,000 babies over the last twenty years in Augusta, Georgia, an area located in a maternity care desert. Her life is certainly meaningful, as she has a clear purpose (provide good maternal care to the people of Georgia, especially Black women, who have a much higher rate of maternal mortality before and after delivery than other women) and significance (some mothers and babies might have died without her care).
questions.prompt: What does Dr. Adams-Pickett report to PBS NewsHour in the passage?
questions.promptZh: 文中亚当斯-皮克特医生向 PBS NewsHour 讲述了什么？
options: Exactly 6,000 births across all of Georgia in a single year.
More than 6,000 deliveries over the twenty-year period described, in Augusta.
Fewer than 600 deliveries before leaving medical practice.
A controlled experiment proving identical outcomes for all mothers.
optionsZh: 一年内在整个佐治亚州恰好接生 6000 次。
所述二十年间在奥古斯塔接生超过 6000 名婴儿。
退出医疗工作前接生少于 600 名婴儿。
证明所有母亲结局相同的对照实验。
analyses: A over 不等于 exactly，twenty years 不是一年，地点也被扩大。
B 保留 shared with PBS NewsHour 的自述来源、over 6,000、二十年和 Augusta。
C 数量和离职情节均不符合原文。
D 个人工作经历不是随机对照实验，也没有相同结局保证。last twenty years 是书中叙述范围，不自动滚动到今天。
